title: The Tall, Tall Tower
themeTags: we need God and each other
reflectionQuestion: The people built a tall tower, but they forgot they needed God and each other. I wonder who helps you, when something is too big to do all by yourself?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (filed under Creation -- primeval Genesis 1-11 bucket). Phase 2 'Beloved' swap-in (replaced Manna per Adam: replayability > lesson density). The strange-wonderful IMAGE is the hook: a tower into the clouds + everyone suddenly speaking different languages. Pride theme SOFTENED per Adam to 'they forgot they needed God, and they forgot they needed each other' -- NO punishment emphasis. The language-change is framed as surprising (a 'wonderful, mixed-up jumble of voices'), the scattering as HOPEFUL (families spreading to fill the world), and the ending is SAFE ('God still loved them -- every family, in every land, speaking every language'). Explains why the world has many languages -- satisfying origin-story for kids. Soft close ('tower'/'clouds'). VOICE_SARAH_STORYTELLER (warm storyteller; 'let me tell you a strange tale' wonder).
